spec.description: FHIR traffic for this HAPI FHIR server by resource type, interaction, and operation, plus subscription delivery and dispatch outcomes by topic (GFE available author/subject and coordination task). Subscription summary panels correlate subscription and payload identifiers; the failure logs panel displays logged errors, not notification bodies. Metrics come from server and subscription counters; unhandled paths come from traces.

spec.title: Requests per minute by interaction
spec.description: Requests per minute grouped by FHIR interaction, averaged over the last 5 minutes.

spec.expr:
sum by (fhir_interaction) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""} offset 5m or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m]) * 0)) / 5

spec.title: Error share by interaction
spec.description: Share of requests in the last 5 minutes that ended in a 4xx or 5xx response, per interaction.

spec.expr:
sum by (fhir_interaction) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_errors_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m])
 - (fhir_server_errors_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""} offset 5m or last_over_time(fhir_server_errors_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m]) * 0))
 / sum by (fhir_interaction) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""} offset 5m or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[5m]) * 0))

spec.title: Minutes since last metric sample
spec.description: Telemetry liveness. The agent exports every 60 s, so a value above 3 means the pipeline is down or the server is.

spec.expr: (time() - max(timestamp(target_info{service_name=~"$service"}))) / 60

spec.title: Resource interactions
spec.description: Requests per FHIR resource type in the selected time range. Types outside telemetry.resource-types count as other.

spec.expr:
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (fhir_resource_type) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_resource_type!=""}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_resource_type!=""} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_resource_type!=""}[$__range]) * 0)) > 0))

spec.title: Operations
spec.description: Requests per registered operation in the selected time range. Names no provider declares count as other.

spec.expr:
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (fhir_operation) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""}[$__range]) * 0)) > 0))

spec.title: Average requests per minute, selected range
spec.description: All interactions combined: requests in the selected time range divided by its length in minutes.

spec.expr:
sum(
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[$__range]) * 0)) / ($__range_s / 60) or vector(0)

spec.title: Top requests (requests in range)
spec.description: Request count per resource type, interaction, and operation over the selected time range, highest first.

spec.expr:
sum by (fhir_resource_type, fhir_interaction, fhir_operation) (
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!=""}[$__range]) * 0)) > 0

spec.title: Average processing time by route (traces)
spec.description: Mean duration of the server spans for each http.route, from Tempo, so no metric series are stored for it. Routes name the request shape, not the resource type.

spec.title: Unhandled request paths (traces)
spec.description: Paths of requests that HAPI bound to no handler, from the url.path of server spans tagged /fhir/unhandled, in the selected time range. Paths carry client text and ids.

spec.title: CPU usage
spec.description: The share of the CPU capacity of the machine that the JVM process used in the latest measurement interval, from jvm.cpu.recent_utilization.

spec.expr: max by (service_name) (jvm_cpu_recent_utilization_ratio{service_name=~"$service"})

spec.title: Memory usage
spec.description: Bytes the JVM uses for heap and non-heap memory, summed over the memory pools, from jvm.memory.used. The dashed line is the heap in use as a share of the heap limit the JVM reports (jvm.memory.limit), on the right axis, with threshold lines at 80% and 90%. The JVM sizes the limit from the container memory limit, 25% of it unless -XX:MaxRAMPercentage says otherwise.

spec.expr: sum by (jvm_memory_type) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service"})
sum(jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service", jvm_memory_type="heap"}) / max(jvm_memory_limit_bytes{service_name=~"$service", jvm_memory_type="heap"})

spec.title: Resource interactions, selected range
spec.description: Requests in the selected range with a FHIR interaction other than an operation: read, vread, search, create, update, patch, delete, history, validate, meta, graphql, capabilities, batch, and transaction. Requests that HAPI bound to no handler are left out.

spec.expr:
sum(
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_interaction!~"operation|unhandled|other"}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_interaction!~"operation|unhandled|other"} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_interaction!~"operation|unhandled|other"}[$__range]) * 0)) or vector(0)

spec.title: Operation invocations, selected range
spec.description: Requests in the selected range that invoked a FHIR operation, such as $everything or $validate, at server, type, or instance level.

spec.expr:
sum(
last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""}[$__range])
 - (fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""} offset $__range or last_over_time(fhir_server_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", fhir_interaction!="", fhir_operation!=""}[$__range]) * 0)) or vector(0)

spec.title: Last server start
spec.description: Start time of the newest JVM that exports the fhir_server_start_time_seconds gauge for the selected service.

spec.expr: max(fhir_server_start_time_seconds{service_name=~"$service"}) * 1000

spec.title: Server starts, selected range
spec.description: JVMs of the selected service whose start time falls inside the selected range. A server that was already running when the range begins adds nothing, so for a single server this is its restart count unless its first start is inside the range.

spec.expr: count(min_over_time(fhir_server_start_time_seconds{service_name=~"$service"}[$__range]) >= time() - $__range_s) or vector(0)

spec.title: Delivery attempts per minute (success vs failure)
spec.description: Delivery attempts per minute by topic and outcome, including retries. Green indicates success; red indicates failure.

spec.expr:
label_replace(round(sum by (topic, outcome) (
last_over_time(pct_subscription_delivery_attempts_total{service_name=~"$service"}[1m])
 - (pct_subscription_delivery_attempts_total{service_name=~"$service"} offset 1m or last_over_time(pct_subscription_delivery_attempts_total{service_name=~"$service"}[1m]) * 0))), "topic", "$1", "topic", ".*/SubscriptionTopic/([^/]+)") > 0

spec.title: Failed delivery attempts by reason
spec.description: Failed delivery attempts per minute by exception type, including retries.

spec.expr:
round(sum by (failure_reason) (
last_over_time(pct_subscription_delivery_attempts_total{service_name=~"$service", outcome="failure"}[1m])
 - (pct_subscription_delivery_attempts_total{service_name=~"$service", outcome="failure"} offset 1m or last_over_time(pct_subscription_delivery_attempts_total{service_name=~"$service", outcome="failure"}[1m]) * 0))) > 0

spec.title: Delivered on first attempt
spec.description: Unique notifications with success and no failed attempt in the selected range, matched by subscription, payload and topic.

spec.expr: count(sum by (subscription, payload, topic) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} |= "delivery succeeded" | regexp `subscription=(?P<subscription>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `payload=(?P<payload>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `topic=(?P<topic>[^\s,]+)` | label_format topic=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/SubscriptionTopic/" .topic "" }}` [$__range])) unless sum by (subscription, payload, topic) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} |= "delivery failed" | regexp `subscription=(?P<subscription>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `payload=(?P<payload>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `topic=(?P<topic>[^\s,]+)` | label_format topic=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/SubscriptionTopic/" .topic "" }}` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Delivered after retry
spec.description: Unique notifications with both failed and successful attempts in the selected range, matched by subscription, payload and topic.

spec.expr: count(sum by (subscription, payload, topic) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} |= "delivery failed" | regexp `subscription=(?P<subscription>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `payload=(?P<payload>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `topic=(?P<topic>[^\s,]+)` | label_format topic=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/SubscriptionTopic/" .topic "" }}` [$__range])) and sum by (subscription, payload, topic) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} |= "delivery succeeded" | regexp `subscription=(?P<subscription>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `payload=(?P<payload>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `topic=(?P<topic>[^\s,]+)` | label_format topic=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/SubscriptionTopic/" .topic "" }}` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: No successful delivery in range
spec.description: Unique notifications with failed attempts and no success in the selected range. Later retries may still succeed.

spec.expr: count(sum by (subscription, payload, topic) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} |= "delivery failed" | regexp `subscription=(?P<subscription>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `payload=(?P<payload>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `topic=(?P<topic>[^\s,]+)` | label_format topic=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/SubscriptionTopic/" .topic "" }}` [$__range])) unless sum by (subscription, payload, topic) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} |= "delivery succeeded" | regexp `subscription=(?P<subscription>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `payload=(?P<payload>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `topic=(?P<topic>[^\s,]+)` | label_format topic=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/SubscriptionTopic/" .topic "" }}` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Failed dispatches
spec.description: Estimated dispatch exceptions in the selected range, separate from delivery failures. Shows 0 when samples are absent or insufficient.

spec.expr: sum(increase(pct_subscription_dispatch_failures_total{service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Subscription failure details
spec.description: Failed attempts by notification and exception type, with success status in the selected range. 'not in log line' means no reason was logged.

spec.expr: (sum by (subscription, payload, topic, fail_reason, status) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} |= "delivery failed" | regexp `subscription=(?P<subscription>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `payload=(?P<payload>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `topic=(?P<topic>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `(?:failure_)?reason=(?P<fail_reason>[^\s,]+)` | label_format topic=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/SubscriptionTopic/" .topic "" }}`, fail_reason=`{{ if .fail_reason }}{{ .fail_reason }}{{ else }}not in log line{{ end }}` | label_format status="Recovered" [$__range])) and on (subscription, payload, topic) sum by (subscription, payload, topic) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} |= "delivery succeeded" | regexp `subscription=(?P<subscription>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `payload=(?P<payload>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `topic=(?P<topic>[^\s,]+)` | label_format topic=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/SubscriptionTopic/" .topic "" }}` [$__range]))) or (sum by (subscription, payload, topic, fail_reason, status) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} |= "delivery failed" | regexp `subscription=(?P<subscription>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `payload=(?P<payload>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `topic=(?P<topic>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `(?:failure_)?reason=(?P<fail_reason>[^\s,]+)` | label_format topic=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/SubscriptionTopic/" .topic "" }}`, fail_reason=`{{ if .fail_reason }}{{ .fail_reason }}{{ else }}not in log line{{ end }}` | label_format status="No success in range" [$__range])) unless on (subscription, payload, topic) sum by (subscription, payload, topic) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} |= "delivery succeeded" | regexp `subscription=(?P<subscription>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `payload=(?P<payload>[^\s,]+)` | regexp `topic=(?P<topic>[^\s,]+)` | label_format topic=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/SubscriptionTopic/" .topic "" }}` [$__range])))

spec.title: pct-coordination-platform-server
